tasks.dev: deno task copy-monaco && deno run -A npm:nuxt dev
tasks.build: deno task copy-monaco && deno run -A npm:nuxt build
tasks.compile: deno task copy-monaco && deno run -A npm:nuxt build && mkdir -p dist && deno compile -A --no-check --unstable-byonm --unstable-node-globals --include .output/public --output dist/noj-ui .output/server/index.mjs
tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno task check:types && deno task check:types:nuxt
tasks.check:types:nuxt: deno run -A npm:nuxt typecheck && node node_modules/vue-tsc/bin/vue-tsc.js --noEmit
tasks.test:coverage: rm -rf coverage && DENO_DIR=.deno_cov_cache deno test -A tests/ --coverage=coverage && DENO_DIR=.deno_cov_cache deno coverage --threshold=60 coverage
